Cross-section showing an earthquake's structure. A diagonal jagged fault line cutting through layers of rock. A bright starburst deep underground on the fault line. Middle: A very wide, flat Shield volcano with gentle slopes and a cutaway showing solid orange lava layers. Right: A small, steep Cinder Cone made entirely of loose grey rock fragments with a wide crater.
